extensionDescription.message: Translate entire web pages in one click — preserves links, images and layout. Works with Google (free) and Azure Translator.

autoTranslateDesc.message: When a page's language differs from your target language, translate it automatically

commandToggleDescription.message: Toggle translation of the current page

optionsSubtitle.message: Translate entire pages while preserving links, images and layout

defaultLanguageDesc.message: The language used when you click "Translate page"

engineDesc.message: Google's free endpoint works out of the box; MyMemory is verified and serves as an independent fallback; Lingva availability varies by region; Azure Translator suits users with a subscription key

apiKeyPlaceholder.message: Paste your Azure Translator resource key

apiKeyHint.message: Create a Translator resource in the Azure Portal to get a key. The legacy free Bing endpoint stopped working in Nov 2026, so this engine now requires a key.

howToUseStep1.message: Click the toolbar icon to open the popup

howToUseStep2.message: Pick your target language and engine

howToUseStep4.message: Right-click any selection to translate just that text

customPresetHint.message: Choosing a preset fills in the endpoint and template below. Replace the URL with your own service. A self-hosted DeepLX / LibreTranslate / OpenAI-compatible relay is usually more reliable than public free endpoints.

customUrlHint.message: Saving or testing asks for permission to access this origin. When the URL is empty the engine is unavailable and the fallback chain skips it.

customTemplateHint.message: Placeholders: {{text}} raw text, {{textJson}} JSON-quoted text, {{from}}/{{to}} language codes, {{toName}} language name, {{token}}, {{model}}

offlineTranslationDesc.message: Translated locally by your browser's built-in model; text never leaves the device. The model for a language pair downloads on first use.

blacklistHint.message: One host per line; supports *.example.com and /path prefixes. Matching sites are never translated — useful for banking, admin consoles, and code hosting.

useOfflineDesc.message: Chrome's built-in AI translates locally — no network, no rate limits; skipped automatically on Edge. Turn off to always use online engines.

translatedStyleHint.message: Visually distinguish translations from source text. Applied via data attributes without changing the page DOM.
